name: John Tate McPhail
locations: Burk Road, Delta Township, Whatcom County, Washington
sources: Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
notes: Married first Evelyn, then Beulah. Farmed on the southwest side of Burk Road, west of the Simons farm. He confirmed the births of his nephew Elmer and niece Edith Kulp when they applied for delayed birth certificates. Children included Emogene (King), Boyd and Geraldine (Miller); which wife was their mother is not stated. [Family research emails, email 48]

Open question: Irma writes 'Uncle Tate and Aunt Beulah McPhail: Dale and Larry', apparently making them grandparents of Dale King and Larry McPhail through Emogene and Boyd; parentage of Emogene, Boyd and Geraldine by Evelyn or Beulah is not stated [Family research emails, email 48]
